title: Cover startup recovery deadline rollover with the scripted budget clock
outcome: Deterministic behavioral coverage proves that a bounded startup recovery pass leaves work it never reached for a later tick when its deadline expires.
acceptance: A scripted-clock behavioral test makes an actual owner read consume the recovery budget, verifies that a subsequent work remains owed and is attempted on a later tick, and verifies startup completion only after the tail is reached; the test does not sleep, pin implementation text or loosen time budgets.
